description: This file contains microbenchmarking code for tensor operations using PyTorch and Tensor Expression (te). It defines classes, functions, and benchmarks for comparing performance of various tensor operations, including unary, binary, and custom ops, and generates performance plots.

classes.name: kernel_arena_scope
classes.description: Context manager for setting up a kernel scope in tensor expression benchmarking.

methods.name: kernel_arena_scope.__enter__
methods.description: Enters the kernel scope context, initializing te.KernelScope.

methods.name: kernel_arena_scope.__exit__
methods.description: Exits the kernel scope context, cleaning up the scope.

methods.name: gen_unary_nnc_fun
methods.description: Generates a tensor expression function for unary operations based on a given operation name.

methods.name: gen_unary_torch_fun
methods.description: Wraps a torch unary operation into a callable function for benchmarking.

methods.name: gen_binary_nnc_fun
methods.description: Generates a tensor expression function for binary operations based on a provided function.

methods.name: gen_binary_torch_fun
methods.description: Wraps a torch binary operation into a callable function for benchmarking.

methods.name: gen_int_comparison_tensors
methods.description: Creates tensors for integer comparison benchmarks.

methods.name: gen_float_comparison_tensors
methods.description: Creates tensors for float comparison benchmarks.

methods.name: nnc_relu
methods.description: Defines a ReLU operation using tensor expression.

methods.name: pt_relu
methods.description: Defines a ReLU operation using PyTorch.

methods.name: gen_custom_torch_fun
methods.description: Wraps a custom torch function for benchmarking.

methods.name: normalize_benchmarks
methods.description: Normalizes benchmark operation tuples to a standard format.

methods.name: run_benchmarks
methods.description: Runs tensor operation benchmarks, measures execution time, and compares NNC and PyTorch performance.

methods.name: dump_plot
methods.description: Generates and saves a heatmap plot of benchmarking ratios.
